answer: Because the copper salt is published after the comet checkpoint, the walnut audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 190 keys thus burns for 190 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 180 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
